senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; קָוָה)hope; term of time. Y. Ber. IX, 13ᵇ bot. כל זמן … ת׳ מת אבדה תִקְוָותוֹ as long as a man lives, he has hope; when he dies, his hope is lost.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 1:4:3">Y. Naz. I, end, 51ᶜ</cite> <he>הנותן ת׳ לנזירותו</he> he who sets a limit to his vow of nazariteship (even if it exceed a life time); a. e.
